name: summon
purpose: Scan a RAR card's QR code with your phone and it installs into your own Brainstem. One agent starts a small sidecar beside the unchanged kernel; it listens only on this Mac and its Tailscale address, and installs through the Brainstem's own /agents/import, which checks every fingerprint.

summon_agent.py.purpose: Drop into (or summon into) a Brainstem's agents/. Say 'start summon' to turn scan-to-summon on.

summond.py.purpose: The sidecar. Fetched and sha256-checked by summon_agent.py from RAR; never run unverified.

install.notes: Drop summon_agent.py into agents/, then say 'start summon'. Requires Tailscale for phones; qrencode for the pairing QR (otherwise a link is shown).
